create_network: create a Network instance from an adjacency list with BPR coefficients for traffic flow modeling
build_vehicle: build a Vehicle object with origin, destination road sections and optional departure time
create_od_demand: create an OriginDestinationDemand instance specifying trip counts between origin and destination
calculate_travel_time: calculate travel time on a road section given volume using the BPR volume-delay function
plot_network: plot a Network using matplotlib quiver arrows with node positions for visualization
